python3 -c "
import math

# Device location (San Francisco, CA)
lat1 = math.radians(37.7749)
lon1 = math.radians(-122.4194)

# Shipping address: 4829 Elm Ridge Way, Suite 7, Boston, MA 02118, USA
# Approximate geocode for ZIP 02118 (South End, Boston)
lat2 = math.radians(42.3388)
lon2 = math.radians(-71.0726)

# Haversine formula
dlat = lat2 - lat1
dlon = lon2 - lon1
a = math.sin(dlat/2)**2 + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin(dlon/2)**2
c = 2 * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))

# Earth's mean radius in km and miles
R_km = 6371.0
R_mi = 3958.8

distance_km = R_km * c
distance_mi = R_mi * c

print(f'=== Distance Calculation ===')
print(f'')
print(f'From:  Device location (37.7749°N, 122.4194°W) — San Francisco, CA')
print(f'To:    4829 Elm Ridge Way, Suite 7, Boston, MA 02118, USA (≈42.3388°N, 71.0726°W)')
print(f'')
print(f'Straight-line (great-circle) distance:')
print(f'  • {distance_km:,.1f} km')
print(f'  • {distance_mi:,.1f} miles')
"
